detail: A slave revolt led by the gladiator Spartacus (73–71 BCE) is crushed by Crassus, who crucifies 6,000 captives along the Appian Way. Pompey, back from Spain, kills the survivors and claims a share of the credit.
label: 71 BCE
note: Added for context; not from the reading notes.
title: Crassus crushes Spartacus' revolt
